| `REQ-001` | A repeatable diagnosis uses the full selected root graph and exact helper, profile, package, shape, and input versions, and reports time spent in the relevant preparation and validation phases., The diagnosis distinguishes observed cost from hypotheses and tests the selected remedy against that cost; an idle retest and small fixtures alone are not treated as a causal explanation. | `active` | 0 | None |

| `REQ-003` | Known valid and deliberately invalid domain/range, cardinality, source, shape, and graph-selection cases retain the correct outcomes before and after the change., No empty graph, sample, skipped required shape, fabricated result, or weakened validator substitutes for the complete validation. | `REQ-004` | Deliberate timeout/resource/cancellation controls produce non-complete structured outcomes, meaningful nonzero failure status, and terminated audit-owned workers without later guarded owner execution., Existing worker, memory, output, query, reasoning, and shared guard-deadline protections remain effective; runtime limits cannot be silently removed or expanded to make the assessment pass. | `active` | 0 | None |

Existing JSON consumers receive a documented migration/compatibility contract without losing component detail. | `active` | 0 | None |

| `REQ-009` | Missing, incomplete, changed, or mismatched bindings and unavailable required backends make the selected guard assessment non-ready; enabled=true and a fixed coverage string are insufficient., All currently declared action families are checked.
